title: When the Interior Burns
author: Noor Quintana
blurb: Bram Hartwell, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
